tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Navy. Headings, logo, primary button fill and the dark section ground. Text on surface, surface-soft and amber (16.9:1, 15.3:1, 8.9:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy, captions and secondary labels on surface and surface-soft (7.3:1, 6.7:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels, links and small accents as TEXT on surface and surface-soft (7.3:1, 6.6:1). Also the right-hand face of the WMS cube mark.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Signal colour: the keystone in the logo, the primary call-to-action fill, step numbers and eyebrows on dark. Always a FILL with ink text on it (8.9:1). Never use as text on surface (1.9:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Default page ground and white cards.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Cool tint for alternating sections, hero and card fills. Pair with ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: surface-dark
tokens.usage: Dark band ground (services, contact banner, dark logo ground). Text on it: on-dark, on-dark-muted, amber.

tokens.name: surface-dark-raised
tokens.usage: Cards lying on surface-dark. Text on it: on-dark (14.2:1), on-dark-muted (9.5:1), amber (7.5:1).

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on surface-dark and surface-dark-raised (16.9:1).

tokens.name: on-dark-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface-dark (11.2:1) and surface-dark-raised (9.5:1).

tokens.name: ice
tokens.usage: Light blue for marks and icons on surface-dark only (7.2:1). Not for body text.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers and hairline borders on surface. Carries no meaning, so it may sit below 3:1; use ink for borders that matter (secondary button, focus ring).
